status: Design handoff; capability support is source-derived, not integrated acceptance

capabilities.dependency: Refresh package version must carry shelf-list home, collection and ingredients layout through exact install/draft/release readback. Preserve old merchant instances and immutable releases.
capabilities.acceptance: Installed package, saved draft, signed preview and published Liquid resolve the same new version.

capabilities.feature: Shelf rows, compact hero, native text and independent recipe/product links
capabilities.dependency: Reuse header/footer/richText/productGrid/productDetail; add bounded shelf-list/ingredients layout settings consumed by Liquid and editor.
capabilities.acceptance: Real collection bindings and independent product destinations survive save/reload.

capabilities.feature: Product price, media, named variants and quantity
capabilities.owner: commerce-core + checkout-core + gateway cart + storefront islands
capabilities.dependency: Wire existing server product/variant/cart owners; source control actions here are presentation only.
capabilities.acceptance: 2 × P-LENT-250 = 2 packs, 500g, ₹360. Stock race preserves selection; pending blocks unintended duplicate action.

capabilities.feature: Ingredients, allergen source/status, storage and optional nutrition
capabilities.owner: commerce-core/shared-types public projection + safe Liquid food facts
capabilities.dependency: Merchant static text can be A; structured food facts require bounded schema, merchant edit/readback and deliberate public drop hydration. Metadata presence alone is not support.
capabilities.acceptance: Correct product facts persist and render; missing allergens remain unknown before CTA; no inferred allergen-free/health badges.

capabilities.feature: Net quantity, pack count and unit-price display
capabilities.dependency: Typed quantity/unit per variant; integer money and normalized grams/millilitres. Unit price server derived with explicit rounding; no cross-dimension comparison.
capabilities.acceptance: 250g at ₹180 renders ₹72/100g; two packs retain ₹360 and 500g; hide unit value if missing quantity or incompatible units.

capabilities.feature: Pack-weight/price facets, sort, counts and pagination
capabilities.owner: gateway paginated product query + storefront data binding
capabilities.dependency: Proposed controls require allowlisted query fields, real supplied counts/options and stable URLs. Hide unsupported facets until complete.
capabilities.acceptance: Apply/remove one filter preserves the other; page totals and clear-query recovery reflect the server.

capabilities.dependency: Canonical error/pending/idempotency behavior; mockup must not be mistaken for successful persistence.
capabilities.acceptance: Network fail keeps confirmed quantity, retry confirms once and server totals replace prior view.

capabilities.feature: Hosted checkout and eligible payment methods
capabilities.dependency: Data-only branding, signed cart-bound handoff, actual server quote/method eligibility and canonical provider outcome. ₹60 shipping and both methods are fixture values.
capabilities.acceptance: Full pack identity and ₹640 quote shown before commitment; retry no double order/payment. Actual live eligibility determines methods.

capabilities.feature: Buyer sign-in, create account, security verification and explicit return
capabilities.dependency: Source observed buyer email/password + configured Turnstile + explicit Continue authorization. No email OTP or mandatory email-verification screen is invented. Theme supplies a validated Pantry destination only.
capabilities.acceptance: Normal registration/security check/login/consent returns safely to same site; expiry preserves safe return; no merchant privilege.

capabilities.feature: Profile, owned orders and saved-address lifecycle
capabilities.owner: canonical buyer and store-customer API/account routes
capabilities.dependency: Existing ownership/permission/pagination/default-address contracts; reachable UI and persistence must be verified during implementation.
capabilities.acceptance: Direct owned order URL works; buyer B cannot read A; edit error retains input; default operation is atomic.

capabilities.dependency: No fabricated rating, sales count, certification, expiry, health or allergen-free claim.

capabilities.feature: Cold chain, rapid delivery, restaurant ordering, subscriptions

capabilities.owner: existing provider/shipping owner under human release authority
capabilities.dependency: No real transaction or delivery guarantee. Server eligibility and provider verification required.

sharedRequest: Coordinator assigns one owner for common food-facts, unit quantity/value, discovery, Liquid schema/editor and catalog changes in Milestone 2. This theme chat changes no production source in Milestone 1.
